'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[:Category:Valuables|Valuable]] item.

== Availability ==
* [[Stone Grave]] and [[Viking Graveyard]] in the [[Meadows]]
* [[Burial Chambers]] and [[Troll Cave]]s in the [[Black Forest]]
* [[Sunken Crypts]] in the [[Swamp]]
* Amber pearl can be obtained from [[Fishing]], as a bonus drop when catching [[Pike]].

== Usage ==

=== Crafting ===
* {{item link|Celebratory Cap}}

=== Selling ===
* As a valuable, it can be sold to any of the [[trader]]s for {{Item Link|Coins|10}}.

'''Trophies''' are [[items]] dropped by defeated [[creatures]] and can stack to 20. == Usage == All trophies have some shared uses: * They can be attached to [[Item Stand]]s to serve as decorations. * They can be used to program the [[Ballista]]. * All trophies will give 1 [[Coal]] per trophy if used in an [[Obliterator]]. Some trophies have special usage: * Some are used as [[crafting]] ingredients. * Some are used to summon [[Forsaken]].
